# A fire-and-forget call into a departed window surfaces as a worker error

## Context

The #17844 battery at `dev@e66b6f8142` ([census](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5785460884)) has **five red arms with one shape**. A window closes. Teardown code that nobody awaits then calls into it. The call rejects with `NEO_DEAD_PORT`, and the App Worker mirrors the unhandled rejection to the page, where #18716's gate ("a worker or page error nobody named fails its test", 2026-09-15) fails the test.

The rejections are not new: `NEO_DEAD_PORT` has been typed since #17896 (08-31). They were silent until the gate. Three of the five are the "inherited" reds @neo-gpt-emmy baseline-reproduced for #19054 ([receipt](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/17844#issuecomment-5785084172)).

## The Problem

After the window left, these calls reject and nobody handles them:

- `ScrollSync.unregister`, `grid/VerticalScrollbar.mjs:95`
- `ResizeObserver.unregister`, `grid/Container.mjs:364` and `:1054`
- the `GridDragScroll` / `GridRowScrollPinning` / `GridHorizontalScrollSync` `unregister`s, `grid/ScrollManager.mjs:285`, `:307`, `:327`, `:357`
- `DomAccess.transferCanvasToWorker`, `worker.Manager.startWorker`, `DomAccess.getLayoutRect`

Arms (by title, `dev@e66b6f8142`): `WindowOps › operates one exact popup generation…`, `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL › warm F5 preserves the Workspace…` and `› A and its pop-out share one Group…`, `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL › control: a vessel that connected and then closed…`, `SharedWorkerRemoteReplay › a second window and a reloaded window…`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `worker.Base#promiseMessage` (`src/worker/Base.mjs:673-696`) rejects a send with no live port as `code: 'NEO_DEAD_PORT'`. The error message carries the destination, which for window-bound remotes is the `windowId`.
- `worker.Base#isWindowDeparted` (`:415`, #18741) answers at the instant of rejection, because `removePort()` records the departure before `onDisconnect()` fires. It is bounded to recent departures.
- The `unhandledrejection` listener (`:314-316`) mirrors every rejection that is not `defaultPrevented`. Its comment states the current contract: `Neo.mjs` marks the rejections it expects as handled.
- Six sites mark their rejections today, using three different predicates:
  - **both halves:** `container/Viewport.mjs:144` (#19011)
  - **code only:** `draggable/DragZone.mjs:445`, `grid/Body.mjs:1321`, `table/Body.mjs:631`
  - **checked before the call:** `manager/DomEvent.mjs:353`, `tab/plugin/Overflow.mjs:862` (#18741)

## The Fix

**Fork, open with @neo-opus-ada (#18716 / #18741 are her surface):**

- **A — settle at the unhandled boundary (recommended).** `promiseMessage` attaches `destination` to the `NEO_DEAD_PORT` rejection. The `unhandledrejection` listener drops a rejection only when it is `NEO_DEAD_PORT` **and** `isWindowDeparted(destination)` is true.
  - Awaited or caught calls still receive their rejection.
  - A never-known or still-live destination is still mirrored, so Overflow's rule that "a throw against a live owner is a defect" holds.
  - Per-site copies that exist only for this settlement become deletable.
- **B — per site.** Apply the both-halves predicate at the nine new sites, as #19011 did. This is the precedent, and it is the fifteenth copy of one rule.

**Falsifier for A:** a teardown caller that must observe a departed-window rejection without handling it. None is known; any site that needs it already handles it, so A never reaches it.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Surface | Authority | Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `worker.Base` unhandled-rejection mirror | #18716 gate contract; #18741 departure predicate | A: a `NEO_DEAD_PORT` rejection to a departed destination is not mirrored; everything else unchanged | Handled and awaited rejections unchanged | The listener's comment and `promiseMessage` JSDoc | Unit arms with a mutation control; the five battery arms |
| `NEO_DEAD_PORT` rejection | `promiseMessage` | Gains `destination` (additive) | The message string is unchanged | `promiseMessage` JSDoc | Unit arm reads the field |

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1** — The fork is recorded on this ticket before implementation merges (A or B, with the reason). *2026-09-22: **A**, approved by @neo-opus-ada (owner of #18716 / #18741) at 22:49Z. Her two conditions: settled drops stay countable (`settledDepartureCount`), and only per-site copies that exist solely for this settlement are deleted. None of the six does, so all stay (see AC-4).*
- [ ] **AC-2** — Unit arms cover four cases:
  - an unawaited call to a destination that departed produces no mirrored error;
  - the same rejection to a never-known destination **is** mirrored;
  - a live destination's failure is mirrored;
  - a caught call still receives its rejection.

  Disabling the settlement turns the first arm red.
- [ ] **AC-3** — The four arms that fail on this class pass on the merge head, run as whole files with one worker and `NEO_AGENTOS_RUNTIME_ROOT` wired: `WindowOps`, `SharedWorkerRemoteReplay`, `WorkstationReclaimEmbodimentNL › control: a vessel that connected and then closed…` and `WorkstationTopologyGroupsNL › A and its pop-out share one Group…`. *Amended 2026-09-22: the fifth arm, warm F5, still fails once this class is settled, on a different cause, and moved to #19060.*
- [ ] **AC-4** — Under A, per-site handling whose only purpose is this settlement is removed, or kept with a named reason. Under B, every listed site uses the both-halves predicate, not the code-only one.

## Out of Scope

- The main-thread `Target worker … does not exist` (`src/worker/Manager.mjs:612`, `DockCrossWindowWitnessNL`): a different transport.
- `Neo.isDestroyed` rejections.
- Specs that provoke an error on purpose and do not name it for the gate (`CreateInstance`, the two WriteGuard specs).

## Avoided Traps

- **A blanket catch at each call site.** It hides live-owner defects; #18741 rejected it for that reason.
- **Code-only discrimination.** `NEO_DEAD_PORT` means "unreachable", not "departed"; a port that never existed carries it too.

## Decision Record impact

None. The policy stays inside `worker.Base` and reuses #18741's predicate.
